svg.aria-label: CodeAtlas architecture: browser clients, Next.js API orchestration layer, the control plane, the Python FastAPI retrieval service, Redis, PostgreSQL, Qdrant, external GitHub and Gemini APIs, and the end-to-end question flow.
svg.text: Generated from the implementation. Two services, three stores, two external APIs.
quota · caches · prompt budget · auth · persistence · request id
THE CONTROL PLANE — what /api/gemini does, in this order
a refusal never reaches the model
hit = no model call, no quota
gitingest is a library imported into this process — not a separate service. 🔒 = requires x-service-token.
every repository filtered by repo payload
text — full-text, backs the keyword arm
Reached only via the Python service.
every call is server-side — no secret reaches the browser
Redis down → 503 quota_unavailable (fails closed) · Qdrant down → whole-repo context, reason: 'unavailable' · not indexed → 'no_matches'
not asked → 'file_scoped' | 'not_attempted' · Postgres down → conversationId: null, answering unaffected · parser down → file is windowed, never lost
